subject: Post-call: procurement pathway & vendor paperwork (NovaPulse)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Judd <claire.j@novapulse.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: procurement pathway & vendor paperwork (NovaPulse)

Hi Claire — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and a proposed next steps list so procurement has what it needs to onboard Redwood quickly.

Call highlights (very high level):
- You want predictable pricing and an onboarding path that doesn’t delay go‑live for the data team.
- Primary priority: clear billing path (PO vs corporate card vs marketplace) and vendor setup (W‑9/W‑8 + banking).
- Secondary: timeline for PO issuance and whether you can accept marketplace billing (AWS Marketplace).

What I need from you to keep momentum:
1) Procurement contact (name + email) to loop in — if possible add them to replies.
2) Preference for billing path (PO / card / marketplace) and standard payment terms (e.g., Net 30).
3) Any vendor portal details or vendor packet template you require (we can fill vendor intake form directly into your portal).

Attachments: I’ve attached a fillable vendor intake form and our vendor packet that includes standard remit and legal info (see attachments below). If you prefer, I can send a DocuSign link for the W‑9 so you don’t have to download/scan.

Attachments: vendor_intake_form_Fillable.pdf, redwood_vendor_packet_v3.zip

Proposed next steps:
- You loop in procurement / ops (if not already) — they tell us PO cadence and any special fields required on the PO.
- We provide a brief quote and sample invoice/PO remit details for your AP team.
- Procurement returns filled intake form and banking details (if required for ACH).

If it helps, I can provide a one‑page “commercial snapshot” that lists exactly what to put on the PO and the fields most AP teams ask for.

Thanks — I’ll follow up on Monday if I haven’t heard back.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0142
From: Claire Judd <claire.j@novapulse.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@novapulse.com>, Procure Team <procure@novapulse.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 09:34:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement pathway & vendor paperwork (NovaPulse)

Ben — thanks for the clear recap and the forms. Forwarding to our procurement team and adding Tom (our procurement lead). Quick answers on our side: we prefer to procure via PO / invoicing (Net 30) — corporate card is rare for platform purchases.

We are interested in marketplace billing (AWS Marketplace) because it simplifies our procurement pipeline, but I need finance confirmation. Can you confirm whether Redwood can list the agreed quote via AWS Marketplace and whether there are any changes to pricing or contract terms if we go that route?

Procurement will need:
- Completed W‑9 (if you are US entity) or W‑8 (if not).
- Banking details for ACH (if they prefer to pay that way).
- A sample PO with your remit address and invoice contact.

I’ve attached our vendor onboarding checklist so you can see what fields the portal will require (internal attachment: NP_vendor_requirements.xlsx). Tom — can you advise on expected lead times for vendor onboarding and whether marketplace would bypass any internal approvals?

Thanks,
Claire
Head of Data Platforms
NovaPulse
claire.j@novapulse.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Procure Team <procure@novapulse.com>, Claire Judd <claire.j@novapulse.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement pathway & vendor paperwork (NovaPulse)

Thanks Claire — appreciate the fast reply and for looping procurement in. Per your asks:
- We are a US entity and can provide a completed W‑9 immediately. I’m sending a DocuSign link for the W‑9 to make it easiest (docuSign link included in attachments).
- Banking details (remit info + ACH routing) are in the vendor packet I attached earlier; if your AP team needs the information in a specific field layout we can reformat to your portal requirements.
- We can publish on AWS Marketplace; that typically requires an additional listing step and can take a couple weeks depending on vendor verification and marketplace ingestion. Pricing can remain consistent with the quote we provided — we can include marketplace listing as an option in the SOW/quote.

I’ve added Laura (Contracts / Billing Ops) and Stephanie (Customer Success / onboarding) to help with PO templates and to accelerate vendor setup. 

Next short steps:
1) Procure team shares your PO template (or the portal fields) — we’ll prefill and return the intake form.
2) We’ll complete the DocuSign W‑9 immediately and upload the signed copy to your portal or return via email per your preference.
3) I’ll attach a short one‑page commercial snapshot that shows the exact invoice fields and the sample invoice you can expect.

Attached: vendor_intake_form_Fillable.pdf, redwood_vendor_packet_v3.zip, docuSign_w9_link.txt

If procurement prefers, Laura can be the invoice contact: laura.bennett@redwood.com — she can also provide our remit address and bank wire instructions.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Procure Team <procure@novapulse.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Claire Judd <claire.j@novapulse.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement pathway & vendor paperwork (NovaPulse)

Thanks — procurement will start vendor onboarding this morning. A couple quick notes:
- We can accept PO / Net 30. Please return the intake form prefilled where possible.
- Please confirm whether Redwood can appear as a listing on AWS Marketplace; that will materially speed internal approvals but requires the marketplace invoice flow.
- We will send our PO template and remit fields by EOD; if we need additional documentation we will follow up.

Tom Ellis
Procurement Lead, NovaPulse
